premise: Raccoon wants a peekaboo game; sleepy Bear cub and jumpy Rabbit play it wrong, until the best BOO makes them all giggle.
inspiration: The folk pattern of three tries (the third one works), turned so the tries are friends' funny mistakes and the success is shared.
lesson: Games are best when you play them together.

en-US.title: Raccoon Plays Peekaboo
en-US.text: [excited] Raccoon {raccoon:hop} had a new game. Who wants to play peekaboo? I'll try, said the bear cub. {bear:pulse} He covered his eyes… {bear:face sleeping} and fell fast asleep. {sfx:snore solo} [giggles] That's not peekaboo, said Raccoon. Rabbit {rabbit:hop x2} bounced over. I'll try! He hid behind the tree and waited. {rabbit:live} His ears went up. He looked left. He looked right. He nibbled a clover leaf. That's not peekaboo either, said Raccoon. [curious] Watch me. {raccoon:live} He rubbed his paws, covered his eyes, peeked out… [surprised] and BOO! The bear cub {bear:face surprised} {bear:wobble} woke up. Rabbit {rabbit:spin} tumbled over. {bear:face happy} {rabbit:face happy} {raccoon:face happy} [laughs] And all three of them giggled {bear:hearts} {rabbit:hearts} until the {tree:wobble} tree shook.

es-ES.title: Mapache juega al cucú-tras
es-ES.text: [excited] Mapache {raccoon:hop} tenía un juego nuevo. ¿Quién quiere jugar al cucú-tras? Yo, dijo el osito. {bear:pulse} Se tapó los ojos… {bear:face sleeping} y se quedó dormido. {sfx:snore solo} [giggles] Eso no es cucú-tras, dijo Mapache. Conejo {rabbit:hop x2} llegó dando botes. ¡Yo! Se escondió detrás del árbol y esperó. {rabbit:live} Levantó las orejas. Miró a la izquierda. Miró a la derecha. Mordisqueó una hoja de trébol. Eso tampoco es cucú-tras, dijo Mapache. [curious] Mirad. {raccoon:live} Se frotó las patitas, se tapó los ojos, asomó un poco… [surprised] ¡y CUCÚ-TRAS! El osito {bear:face surprised} {bear:wobble} se despertó. Conejo {rabbit:spin} se cayó de espaldas. {bear:face happy} {rabbit:face happy} {raccoon:face happy} [laughs] Y los tres se rieron {bear:hearts} {rabbit:hearts} hasta que el {tree:wobble} árbol tembló.

snore.prompt: a tiny bear cub's soft, cute sleepy snore, one breath in and out
